name: Marital Fight
overview: Scripture affirms the blessing and favor that comes from finding a godly spouse, emphasizing the importance of love and reverence within marriage. Believers are called to embody humility, patience, kindness, and forgiveness toward one another, reflecting God's grace through Christ. Husbands are instructed to love their wives as themselves, while wives are to show respect to their husbands, fostering unity and mutual honor. Focusing on what is true, pure, and lovely helps maintain a Christ-centered perspective in marital relationships.
